import pytest
from pkg.math import add, parse


def test_add():
    assert add(1, 2) == 3


def test_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse("x")


def test_helper():
    """Uses a project helper."""
    check_tree(parse("{}"))


class TestMath:
    def test_method(self):
        self.assertEqual(add(2, 2), 4)
